ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ
en: (1) By the mount
tr: Waṭ-ṭūr

ar: وَكِتَٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
en: (2) And [by] a Book inscribed[1550]
enNotes: [1550]- Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.
tr: Wakitābim masṭūr

ar: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
en: (3) In parchment spread open
tr: Fī raqqim manshūr

ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
en: (4) And [by] the frequented House[1551]
enNotes: [1551]- The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.
tr: Wal-baytil-maʿmūr

ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
en: (5) And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
tr: Was-saqfil-marfūʿ

ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
en: (6) And [by] the sea set on fire,[1552]
enNotes: [1552]- On the Day of Resurrection. Or "the sea which has overflowed."
tr: Wal-baḥril-masjūr

ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
en: (7) Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
tr: Inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿ

ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
en: (8) Of it there is no preventer.
tr: Mā lahū min dāfiʿ

ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
en: (9) On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
tr: Yawma tamūrus-samāʾu mawrā

ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
en: (10) And the mountains will pass on, departing[1553] -
enNotes: [1553]- Becoming dust and moving as clouds.
tr: Watasīrul-jibālu sayrā

ar: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: (11) Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
tr: Fawayluy yawmaʾidhil lil-mukadhdhibīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: (12) Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
tr: Al-ladhīna hum fī khawḍiy yalʿabūn

ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
en: (13) The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
tr: Yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿā

ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: (14) "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
tr: Hādhihin-nārul-latī kuntum bihā tukadhdhibūn

ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
en: (15) Then is this magic, or do you not see?
tr: Afasiḥrun hādhā am antum lā tubṣirūn

ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (16) [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
tr: Iṣlawhā faṣbirū aw lā taṣbirū, sawāʾun ʿalaykum, innamā tujzawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
en: (17) Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
tr: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw wanaʿīm

ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: (18) Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
tr: Fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum, wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhābal-jaḥīm

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (19) [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
tr: Kulū washrabū hanīʾam bimā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
en: (20) They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr: Muttakiʾīna ʿalā sururim maṣfūfah, wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
en: (21) And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]
enNotes:
[1554]- i.e., the reward thereof.
[1555]- i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū wattabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biʾīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayʾ, kullumriʾim bimā kasaba rahīn

ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
en: (22) And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
tr: Waʾamdadnāhum bifākihatiw walaḥmim mimmā yashtahūn

ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
en: (23) They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
tr: Yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kaʾsal lā laghwun fīhā walā taʾthīm

ar: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
en: (24) There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
tr: Wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghilmānul lahum kaʾannahum luʾluʾum maknūn

ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
en: (25) And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr: Waʾaqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍiy yatasāʾalūn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
en: (26) They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
tr: Qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mushfiqīn

ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
en: (27) So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
tr: Famannallāhu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhābas-samūm

ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (28) Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
tr: Innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūh, innahū huwal-barrur-raḥīm

ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
en: (29) So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
tr: Fadhakkir famā anta biniʿmati rabbika bikāhiniw walā majnūn

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
en: (30) Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?[1557]
enNotes: [1557]- i.e., some accident or inevitable death.
tr: Am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihī raybal-manūn

ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
en: (31) Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
tr: Qul tarabbaṣū faʾinnī maʿakum minal-mutarabbiṣīn

ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
en: (32) Or do their minds[1558] command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
enNotes: [1558]- In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.
tr: Am taʾmuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūn

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (33) Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
tr: Am yaqūlūna taqawwalah, bal lā yuʾminūn

ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (34) Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
tr: Falyaʾtū biḥadīthim mithlihī in kānū ṣādiqīn

ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
en: (35) Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
tr: Am khuliqū min ghayri shayʾin am humul-khāliqūn

ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
en: (36) Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
tr: Am khalaqus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, bal lā yūqinūn

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
en: (37) Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
tr: Am ʿindahum khazāʾinu rabbika am humul-musayṭirūn

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (38) Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
tr: Am lahum sullamuy yastamiʿūna fīh, falyaʾti mustamiʿuhum bisulṭānim mubīn

ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
en: (39) Or has He daughters while you have sons?
tr: Am lahul-banātu walakumul-banūn

ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
en: (40) Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr: Am tasʾaluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim muthqalūn

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
en: (41) Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr: Am ʿindahumul-ghaybu fahum yaktubūn

ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
en: (42) Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
tr: Am yurīdūna kaydā, fal-ladhīna kafarū humul-makīdūn

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (43) Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
tr: Am lahum ilāhun ghayrullāh, subḥānallāhi ʿammā yushrikūn

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
en: (44) And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,[1559] they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
enNotes: [1559]- Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.
tr: Waʾiy yaraw kisfam minas-samāʾi sāqiṭay yaqūlū saḥābum markūm

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
en: (45) So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
tr: Fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumul-ladhī fīhi yuṣʿaqūn

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (46) The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
tr: Yawma lā yughnī ʿanhum kayduhum shayʾaw walā hum yunṣarūn

ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (47) And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment[1560] before that, but most of them do not know.
enNotes: [1560]- If not in this world, in the grave.
tr: Waʾinna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
en: (48) And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
tr: Waṣbir liḥukmi rabbika faʾinnaka biʾaʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūm

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
en: (49) And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
tr: Waminal-layli fasabbiḥhu waʾidbāran-nujūm
